transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm seeking help because I've been feeling extremely jumpy and am having a really hard time remembering what happened during a very stressful event about two weeks ago. It's making me really anxious that my memory of that day is so blank.
Did the stressful event involve actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence to you or someone else? Also, have these symptoms been happening since that event two weeks ago?

Yes, these symptoms have been happening constantly for the last two weeks since the event. However, I'm having a really hard time answering if there was threatened death or injury because I honestly can't remember the details of what happened. Almost the entire event is just a blank space in my mind.
Just to clarify, did these symptoms start within 3 days of the event, and has it been less than 1 month since it happened?
Yes, they started almost immediately, within a day or two after it happened. It has been exactly two weeks now, so it's definitely been less than a month.
Since the event, have you been having unwanted memories, nightmares, or flashbacks about it?
No, I haven't really experienced any nightmares or flashbacks since it happened. Because so much of the event is a blank to me, I don't get those vivid, unwanted memories either.
Since the event, have you felt detached from yourself or your surroundings, like things aren’t real or you’re in a daze?
No, I haven't really experienced feeling detached or like things around me aren't real. I don't feel like I'm in a daze or disconnected at all.
Since the event, have you been avoiding reminders of it, like certain places, people, conversations, or even trying not to think about it?
I haven't really noticed myself actively avoiding any places, people, or conversations. Since I can't remember most of what happened anyway, I'm not really sure what I would even be trying to avoid.
Besides feeling jumpy, have you also had trouble sleeping, difficulty concentrating, irritability, or feeling constantly on guard since the event?
I haven't really noticed having any trouble sleeping, irritability, or difficulty concentrating since it happened. I'm not really sure about those symptoms, as they haven't really stood out to me.
Have these symptoms been causing significant problems in your daily life, like at work, school, or in relationships?

I haven't really thought about it much, so I'm not entirely sure how it has affected my daily life yet. I've just been so focused on trying to figure out my memory that I haven't really noticed its impact on my work or relationships.
Has anyone told you that during the event you were in serious danger, badly hurt, or at risk of sexual assault, even if you can’t remember it yourself?
I'm really not sure, as no one has told me anything like that. Since I can't recall those details myself, I don't have any information about what actually happened.
Besides the event itself, have you had trouble remembering other important personal information, or is the memory gap only for that stressful event?

No, my memory trouble is strictly limited to that stressful event itself. I remember my personal details and other aspects of my life perfectly fine. It is just that specific day where I have massive blank spots and can't recall what happened.
